fixture: Passive ticks are paused. After fair arrival, skip_to stages real calendar times and leaves skipped prayers unplayed. The player is placed at the named place marker. For a16, the player looks down the lane from a1 toward the square. Wallet and trust begin at 198 and 45, with a 20-coin shortage in a05 and trust set back to 45 after telling Saeed in a04. Purchases, prayer, intention, distribution and record outcomes are produced by the game.
method: Native Godot viewport with production buttons for fair arrival, telling Saeed, buying a sheep, intending the fast, Eid prayer, both distributions and opening the private prayer record.
